en.abdullah-al-shahin: (16) Muhammad bin Ya’qoob al-Kulayni narrated from al-Husayn bin Muhammad from Ja’far bin Muhammad from al-Qassim bin Issma’eel from Yahya bin al-Muthanna from Abdullah bin Bukayr from Obayd bin Zurara that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) had said:
“Al-Qa’im (as) disappears twice. During one of his disappearances, he attends the seasons of hajj. He sees the people but they do not see him.”
